change: Add a Rank the lines mode to the best fit workshop

mutations.name: a miss is taken as the line's height minus y
the misses are added without squaring
the ranks are read from worst to best
misses that cancel are told for the best line too
a line through one point counts as through two
a squared loss is told the wrong way round
the slip shows the misses without their squares
the slip says the rank the player gave as the right one
mutations.find: so it ranks ${this.ORD[this.truth(i)]}. You had it
mutations.replace: so it ranks ${this.ORD[this.calls[i]]}. You had it

mutations.name: the misses are drawn to the axis
mutations.find: if(y!==h) out+=`<line data-k="miss-seg" clip-path="url(#frkClip${i})" x1="${f(PX(x))}" y1="${f(PY(h))}"
mutations.replace: if(y!==h) out+=`<line data-k="miss-seg" clip-path="url(#frkClip${i})" x1="${f(PX(x))}" y1="${f(PY(0))}"

mutations.name: the ring goes on the lines ranked right
mutations.find: if(this.marks && this.marks[i]===false) out+=`<rect data-k="miss" x="${X+3}" y="${Y+3}" width="174" height="114" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="${FIG_COL.d}" stroke-width="2.5"/>`;
mutations.replace: if(this.marks && this.marks[i]===true) out+=`<rect data-k="miss" x="${X+3}" y="${Y+3}" width="174" height="114" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="${FIG_COL.d}" stroke-width="2.5"/>`;

mutations.name: a fix counts as a first check
the panes are not given their ranks once solved
rank the lines is not offered as a tab
mutations.find: ,['rank','🏅 Rank the lines','See four lines through the same points, and rank them from the best fit to the worst']]
